name: dumbbell alternate hammer preacher curl
description: Alternating hammer curls on a preacher bench. It builds the brachialis and the biceps with strict form.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Keep one arm straight and curl the other dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly to a straight arm.
Curl the other dumbbell the same way.
